title: Foundry Construction Intern – Undergraduate
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Opportunity
Join Intel and help build the future of semiconductor manufacturing.
Intel's Foundry Construction and Sourcing organization brings together the teams that source, plan, engineer, and build the facilities and infrastructure that enable semiconductor manufacturing.
As an intern, you'll work on real projects alongside professionals across supply chain, sourcing, construction, engineering, and construction project management. Your assignment will be matched to your academic background, skills, interests, and business needs.
What You May Work On
Internship opportunities may include:
Construction and Engineering
Construction project management and engineering
Project planning, cost, schedule, and controls
Tool-install and facilities construction
Design coordination and field validation
Contractor and vendor coordination
Safety, quality, and continuous improvement
What You'll Do
Depending on your assignment, you may:
Analyze data and turn insights into recommendations.
Support the planning and execution of construction, sourcing, or supply chain projects.
Work with suppliers, contractors, engineers, factory teams, and other business partners.
Help improve processes, tools, systems, cost, quality, and execution.
Prepare project updates, analyses, and recommendations.
Apply what you're learning in school to complex, real-world business and technical challenges.
What You'll Gain
Hands-on experience in semiconductor manufacturing, construction, sourcing, and/or supply chain.
Exposure to large-scale technical and business projects.
Experience working with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and contractors.
Opportunities to build analytical, technical, project-management, and communication skills.
Mentorship and professional development from experienced professionals.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
You must be currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as:
Construction Management or Construction Engineering
Industrial, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical/Process, Materials, or Computer Engineering
Data Science or Computer Science
Some assignments may require on-site work in a construction, manufacturing, or industrial environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Coursework, projects, internships, or experience in areas such as:
Construction or project management
Engineering or manufacturing
Supplier or contractor management
Data analytics or visualization
Project controls, cost, or scheduling
Process improvement
Semiconductor manufacturing or construction
We're looking for students who are curious, collaborative, analytical, comfortable solving problems, and excited to learn in a fast-moving environment. Source it. Plan it. Engineer it. Build it.
Explore the opportunity to apply your skills, gain valuable experience, and contribute to impactful projects in a global organization. Take the first step toward shaping your future by applying today.
Job Type:
Student / Intern
Shift:
Shift 1 (Malaysia)
Primary Location:
Malaysia, Penang
Additional Locations:
Malaysia, Kulim
Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.
Position of Trust
N/A
Work Model for this Role
This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.
*
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.
